Delhi High Court seeks NTA response on UGC-NET English re-test plea

The Delhi High Court has requested a response from the National Testing Agency (NTA) and the Central Government regarding a petition challenging the decision to re-conduct the UGC-NET English examination for June 2024. The petitioner claims the decision to hold a re-test was arbitrary, unreasonable, and procedurally unfair. The plea further alleges that the NTA's action violates Article 14 of the Constitution, which guarantees the right to equality. The court is seeking a formal reply to address these challenges to the NTA's decision.
